questions.question: Under ISA 701 (Communicating Key Audit Matters in the Independent Auditor's Report), which of the following statements correctly describes the audit requirements regarding Key Audit Matters (KAMs)?
options: Communicating KAMs is mandatory in the auditor's report for audits of complete sets of general purpose financial statements of listed entities.
The auditor's communication of KAMs serves as a replacement for management's required disclosures in the financial statements.
The identification and communication of a KAM automatically requires the auditor to issue a qualified audit opinion.
Communicating KAMs provides a separate audit opinion on the specific financial statement line items to which they refer.

questions.question: Under IFRS 16 Leases, how should a lessee initially measure a right-of-use (ROU) asset at the commencement date of the lease?
options: At the total undiscounted contractual lease payments plus any residual value guarantee provided by the lessee.
At the fair value of the underlying asset minus any initial direct costs incurred by the lessee.
At the initial measurement of the lease liability, adjusted for pre-commencement lease payments, initial direct costs, and estimated restoration obligations, less lease incentives received.
At the present value of future lease payments discounted at the risk-free rate, excluding restoration obligations.

questions.question: According to ISA 320 (Materiality in Planning and Performing an Audit), what is the primary objective of the auditor when setting performance materiality?
options: To set a threshold below which identified misstatements are deemed clearly trivial and do not need to be accumulated.
To determine the maximum monetary misstatement that management can leave uncorrected without altering the audit opinion.
To eliminate the risk of uncorrected misstatements occurring in individual account balances or transaction classes.
To reduce to an appropriately low level the probability that the aggregate of uncorrected and undetected misstatements exceeds materiality for the financial statements as a whole.

questions.question: On January 1, 2024, Alpha Corp acquired an 80% controlling interest in Beta Corp for $480,000 cash. On that date, Beta Corp's net identifiable assets had a fair value of $500,000. The fair value of the 20% non-controlling interest (NCI) was determined to be $110,000. If Alpha Corp elects to measure NCI at fair value (full goodwill method) under IFRS 3, what is the recognized amount of goodwill at the acquisition date?
Under IFRS 8 Operating Segments, which of the following quantitative criteria qualifies an operating segment to be separately reported?
options: Its total assets are 5% or more of the combined assets of all operating segments.
Its external revenues represent at least 10% of total consolidated entity revenue.
Its reported assets are 10% or more of the combined assets of all operating segments.
Its total liabilities represent 10% or more of combined liabilities of all operating segments.
